reviewed_by: Claude (py-test-rot runtime group); selection reviewed against the diff by the implementing agent; repairs made by a subagent and re-verified locally
reason: Test-only repair. Staged test workers could not import nebula: detached_worker_environment drops PYTHONPATH, so in an environment without the installed package every staged program died at import ('worker startup exited'). The shared managed.stage() in test_runtime_processes.py now puts the repository src on sys.path, restoring the runtime suites selected here. Other files follow #939 (async stubs, awaited calls, an async viewer task) or cite the change behind a stale expectation: #974 goal metadata keys, 64e0379 memory-runner hold for api-owned Host commands, #1023 host reconnect wait.
exclusions: Unselected because they need this host's missing LAN address or a production UI build: test_runtime_host_knowledge_bootstrap (LAN), test_runtime_host_operator (LAN), test_runtime_work_batch_integration (ui/dist). test_runtime_browser_bridge timed out in the local re-run under heavy host load and is left for a later pass. PostgreSQL variants skip without NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL.
